name: Canadian Manganese Company Inc.
summary: Canadian Manganese Company Inc. focuses on the exploration and development of manganese deposits within the province of New Brunswick, Canada. The company's principal holding is an interest in the Woodstock project, which encompasses mineral claim number 5472. This significant property consists of 232 mineral claim units, spanning 5,875 hectares in Carleton County, New Brunswick. Established in 2011, the firm's corporate headquarters are located in Toronto, Canada.
